headline: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
context: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.

sources.name: BBC
